tokenize_cpp_source: run the C++ tokenizer on a source file to extract all tokens with their types and positions
create_token_object: create a Token object with a token type, name, start index, and end index for C++ code analysis
extract_string_literal: use _GetString to find the end position of a double-quoted string literal handling escape sequences
extract_char_literal: use _GetChar to find the end position of a single-quoted character literal handling escape sequences
review_GetTokens: review the GetTokens generator function that yields Token objects for NAME, SYNTAX, CONSTANT, and PREPROCESSOR types
